description: Use Cube's governed business data through MCP to answer questions, build analytics content, and work with the semantic model.

interface.longDescription: Cube connects ChatGPT and Codex to governed business data. Users can explore the semantic model, answer analytical questions with Cube SQL, build and publish dashboards and reports, inspect pre-aggregations, and edit data models on isolated development branches within their existing Cube permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use Cube to show revenue by product category for the last complete quarter.
Use Cube to find the revenue measure and explain how it is defined.
Use Cube to save a verified query as a report in a workbook.

publication.release_notes: Adds five MCP-backed Cube skills for model exploration, governed queries, analytics content, semantic model edits, and Cube agent configuration.
